Personal Loan Disclosure
Annual Percentage Rate (APR): 9.99%. This is a variable rate loan, and your APR may increase if the prime rate rises.
An origination fee of 2.5% of the loan amount will be deducted from your proceeds.
If any payment is more than 15 days past due, a late fee of $25 or 5% of the payment, whichever is greater, will be charged.
There is no prepayment penalty.
